V17's 30-pair minimum cannot apply to these declared series; the D2 guard was set to the cycle's own floor of 8 aligned pairs (recorded in the artifact method; the 0.20 bar unchanged).

FUNDJUMP funding-LEVEL veto covers BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT rows only (16/24 A4 rows, 8/12 A5-P1 rows, 16/24 A5-P2 rows): the inherited V17 family spec pools BTC/ETH and never had SOL; SOL rows are excluded from that pair and never imputed (coverage recorded per pair).

Daily veto values are dated D = the decision's UTC date per the inherited V17 exposure-vs-proxy convention; tsmom28/daily-ret proxies dated D include day-D price action that partially overlaps the proposal hold, biasing |rho| upward (conservative, kill-direction bias for a veto gate).

Calendar/session dummies, the weekend flag, the WKNDLIQ flag and (on A4 grids) the SILRES trigger are constant on the decision grids: recorded DEGENERATE_ZERO_VARIANCE / UNMEASURED, never inferred PASS; the liquidity-level content they proxy for is measured by the varying dvol_level_log/dvol_shock rows, which vetoed all four proposals.
